data.body_html:
Planning a family yacht charter in Marbella for 2027? One of the most common questions we get is about age restrictions. The short answer: there is no minimum age for private yacht charters in Marbella. Infants, toddlers, teenagers, and grandparents are all welcome on board. This guide covers everything you need to know about the marbella yacht charter minimum age policy for 2027, including capacity limits, safety, and jet ski rules.

No Minimum Age for Private Charters

Unlike some commercial boat trips or water parks, private yacht charters in Marbella have no lower age limit. You can bring a newborn, a toddler, or a group of teenagers. The yacht is yours for the duration, so you decide who comes along. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella Marina, or Cabopino, and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

Children Count Towards Passenger Capacity

While there is no minimum age, everyone on board counts towards the boat's maximum passenger limit. For example, the Astondoa 40 holds 9 people, the Azimut 39 holds 11, and the Mangusta 80 holds 12. Infants and children are included in these numbers. Always check the passenger capacity when booking to ensure your group fits comfortably.

Jet Ski Age Restrictions

If you book a Tier B charter like the Mangusta 80 (white or grey), you get a free jet ski included. Jet ski drivers must typically be at least 16 years old and hold a valid jet ski licence. Passengers of any age can ride with a licensed adult. For other boats, jet skis can be added on request with the same age rules.

Safety Equipment for All Ages

Every charter includes life jackets for adults and children. We recommend bringing your own infant life jacket for the best fit, though standard ones are available. The skipper will give a safety briefing and advise on safe areas for children to move around. Most boats have shaded areas, guardrails, and calm-water routes ideal for families.

Booking with Infants and Toddlers

Infants under 1 are welcome. Let us know in advance so we can prepare appropriate safety equipment. The charter price remains the same regardless of age. Popular family-friendly boats include the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) and the Lagoon 380 catamaran (11.6m, 10 pax), both offering plenty of deck space.

Teenagers and Young Adults

Teenagers are welcome as passengers, but a responsible adult (18+) must be present on the booking and on board. The skipper is in charge of the vessel, but the lead passenger must be over 18. For young adults looking to celebrate a birthday or graduation, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) is a popular choice.

Pricing and Booking

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and VAT. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for 4 hours with a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. All charters include fuel, insurance, and safety equipment.
